description: This file defines the PBACRoleManager class, which manages role assignments and permission checks within an organization or team, including validation to prevent removing the last owner.

classes.name: PBACRoleManager
classes.description: A class that manages role assignments and permission validation for organizations and teams, implementing the IRoleManager interface.

methods.name: checkPermissionToChangeRole
methods.description: Checks if a user has permission to change a role within a scope ('org' or 'team'). Throws an error if permission is denied.

methods.name: validateNotLastOwner
methods.description: Validates that the role change does not remove the last owner in an organization or team.

methods.name: assignRole
methods.description: Assigns a role to a member, handling default, ID-based, and custom roles with validation.

methods.name: getAllRoles
methods.description: Retrieves all roles associated with an organization.

methods.name: getTeamRoles
methods.description: Retrieves all roles associated with a team.
